newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares seen slipping on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares seen slipping on profit-taking.

text.p: Danish share prices slipped in early trading on Tuesday after Monday's new record closing high in a market expected by dealers to decline slightly on profit-taking and the overnight Dow fall.
"The market seems overbought at the moment. The Dow fall and expected profit-taking after the recent days' records probably means we will see prices trickle down," one dealer said.
The KFX top-20 index had lost 0.11 point to 171.36 at 0720 GMT, after closing 0.24 point higher at a record closing high for the fourth consecutive trading day on Monday.
